name: On sale
description: Products priced below their usual price, with the saving shown.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/sale-products", name: "On sale", kind: Kind.productCollection,
  description: "Products priced below their usual price, with the saving shown.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [ForEach(items: options.products, as: "p", child: If(condition: p.compare_at_price_cents > p.display_price_cents, then: Box(padding: Space.md, radius: Radius.md, background: Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), child: Row(gap: Space.md, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [
      Expanded(child: Text(child: p.name, weight: FontWeight.semibold)),
      Text(child: formatMoney(p.compare_at_price_cents), color: Color.textMuted, decoration: TextDecoration.lineThrough),
      Text(child: formatMoney(p.display_price_cents), weight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color.danger)
    ]))))])
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "products", type: Product, list: true, required: true)],
)
